configs.name: rates
configs.description: Every change point of the policy rate, with the level before and after, its era and its source.
configs.grain: One row per change in the rate

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the jurisdiction (EA for the euro area).

columns.name: country
columns.description: Jurisdiction name.

columns.name: central_bank
columns.description: Central bank that sets the rate.

columns.name: instrument
columns.description: The policy instrument in force on this date.

columns.name: effective_date
columns.description: Date the new rate took effect (the bank’s local date).

columns.name: level_kind
columns.description: `point` for a single rate, `range` for a target range (the US since 16 Dec 2008).

columns.name: rate_pct
columns.description: The rate in percent: the point, or the upper bound of a range. Never a midpoint.

columns.name: rate_bps
columns.description: The same rate as an exact integer number of basis points.

columns.name: rate_low_pct
columns.description: Lower bound of a range in percent; equals `rate_pct` for a point rate.

columns.name: rate_high_pct
columns.description: Upper bound of a range in percent; equals `rate_pct`.

columns.name: previous_rate_pct
columns.description: The rate in force before this change, in percent (upper bound for a range). Null for the first point.

columns.name: change_bps
columns.description: Signed change in basis points against the previous upper bound. Null for the first point and when the instrument or its basis changes (an era boundary), where the two rates are not comparable.

columns.name: direction
columns.description: `hike`, `cut`, `initial` (first point) or `era_change` (a new instrument or basis).

columns.name: era_id
columns.description: The period of one rate basis this row belongs to; joins to `eras`.

columns.name: era_basis
columns.description: `policy` for the policy rate itself, `observation` for an earlier proxy rate kept for history.

columns.name: evidence
columns.description: `official` when the point comes from the central bank’s own series or statement, `secondary` when from a cited secondary source.

columns.name: source_id
columns.description: The source of this point; joins to `sources`.

columns.name: source_url
columns.description: URL of that source.

columns.name: decision_id
columns.description: The announced decision that set this rate, when the decision ledger has it; joins to `decisions`.

columns.name: release_hash
columns.description: SHA-256 content hash of the release this row was built from.

columns.name: record_text
columns.description: One deterministic sentence describing the row, for search and retrieval. Generated from the fields, not written by a model.

configs.name: daily
configs.description: The rate in force on every calendar day, from 1 Jan 2000 (or the first point of the series, if later) to the date the official series was last observed. Ready to join to any daily or monthly data.
configs.grain: One row per calendar day per country

columns.name: date
columns.description: Calendar date.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the jurisdiction (EA for the euro area).

columns.name: level_kind
columns.description: `point` for a single rate, `range` for a target range (the US since 16 Dec 2008).

columns.name: rate_pct
columns.description: The rate in percent: the point, or the upper bound of a range. Never a midpoint.

columns.name: rate_bps
columns.description: The same rate as an exact integer number of basis points.

columns.name: rate_low_pct
columns.description: Lower bound of a range in percent; equals `rate_pct` for a point rate.

columns.name: rate_high_pct
columns.description: Upper bound of a range in percent; equals `rate_pct`.

columns.name: era_id
columns.description: The period of one rate basis this row belongs to; joins to `eras`.

columns.name: era_basis
columns.description: `policy` for the policy rate itself, `observation` for an earlier proxy rate kept for history.

columns.name: is_change
columns.description: True on the day a new rate took effect.

configs.name: decisions
configs.description: Every announced decision in the ledger, from the bank’s own statement or resolution: hikes, cuts and holds, with the vote, stance, a short excerpt and the statement link.
configs.grain: One row per announced decision, including holds

columns.name: decision_id
columns.description: Stable decision identifier, `{country}-{announcement date}`.

columns.name: meeting_id
columns.description: The scheduled meeting this decision came from; null for an unscheduled (off-cycle) decision. Joins to `meetings`.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the jurisdiction (EA for the euro area).

columns.name: country
columns.description: Jurisdiction name.

columns.name: central_bank
columns.description: Central bank that sets the rate.

columns.name: decision_body
columns.description: The committee that took the decision.

columns.name: instrument
columns.description: The policy instrument.

columns.name: announced_at
columns.description: Announcement time in UTC.

columns.name: announced_at_local
columns.description: Announcement time as published, with the bank’s UTC offset (ISO 8601).

columns.name: announced_date
columns.description: Announcement date in the bank’s local time.

columns.name: effective_date
columns.description: Date the decided rate took effect (the next day for the Fed).

columns.name: level_kind
columns.description: `point` for a single rate, `range` for a target range (the US since 16 Dec 2008).

columns.name: rate_pct
columns.description: The rate in percent: the point, or the upper bound of a range. Never a midpoint.

columns.name: rate_bps
columns.description: The same rate as an exact integer number of basis points.

columns.name: rate_low_pct
columns.description: Lower bound of a range in percent; equals `rate_pct` for a point rate.

columns.name: rate_high_pct
columns.description: Upper bound of a range in percent; equals `rate_pct`.

columns.name: direction
columns.description: `hike`, `cut` or `hold`.

columns.name: change_bps
columns.description: Signed change in basis points; 0 for a hold. Null when the decision changed the instrument itself.

columns.name: off_cycle
columns.description: True for an unscheduled decision between meetings.

columns.name: era_change
columns.description: True when the decision introduced a new instrument or basis (for example the Fed’s move to a target range).

columns.name: vote_for
columns.description: Members voting for the decision; null where the vote is not captured.

columns.name: vote_against
columns.description: Members voting against; null where the vote is not captured.

columns.name: dissents
columns.description: Names or descriptions of dissenting votes, as published; empty when there were none or none were captured.

columns.name: unanimous
columns.description: True when no member voted against; null where the vote is not captured.

columns.name: stance
columns.description: The policy stance as stated by the bank (for example `neutral`, `calibrated tightening`), where it states one.

columns.name: statement_url
columns.description: Link to the official statement or resolution.

columns.name: excerpt
columns.description: A short excerpt from the statement (at most 400 characters).

columns.name: evidence
columns.description: `statement` for a decision read from the bank’s own statement or resolution.

columns.name: source_ids
columns.description: Sources for this decision; join to `sources`.

columns.name: release_hash
columns.description: SHA-256 content hash of the release this row was built from.

columns.name: record_text
columns.description: One deterministic sentence describing the decision, for search and retrieval. Generated from the fields, not written by a model.

configs.name: meetings
configs.description: The meeting calendar, including meetings still to come, with the decision each held meeting produced.
configs.grain: One row per scheduled meeting, past and upcoming

columns.name: meeting_id
columns.description: Stable meeting identifier, `{country}-{decision date}`.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the jurisdiction (EA for the euro area).

columns.name: meeting_start
columns.description: First day of a multi-day meeting.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Decision day.

columns.name: announce_at
columns.description: Scheduled announcement time in UTC.

columns.name: announce_at_local
columns.description: Scheduled announcement time with the bank’s UTC offset (ISO 8601).

columns.name: status
columns.description: `held`, `scheduled`, `cancelled` or `moved`.

columns.name: effective_lag_days
columns.description: Days between the announcement and the date a new rate takes effect.

columns.name: decision_id
columns.description: The decision this meeting produced; joins to `decisions`.

columns.name: source_id
columns.description: The calendar source; joins to `sources`.

configs.name: cycles
configs.description: Each run of consecutive moves in one direction since the policy-rate era began, computed exactly as on the site: a cycle starts with the first move after a move the other way.
configs.grain: One row per tightening or easing cycle

columns.name: cycle_id
columns.description: Stable identifier, `{country}-{direction}-{start date}`.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the jurisdiction (EA for the euro area).

columns.name: direction
columns.description: `tightening` (hikes) or `easing` (cuts).

columns.name: start_date
columns.description: Effective date of the first move.

columns.name: end_date
columns.description: Effective date of the last move so far.

columns.name: moves
columns.description: Number of moves in the cycle.

columns.name: total_bps
columns.description: Signed total change from the rate before the cycle to its last move, in basis points.

columns.name: days
columns.description: Days from the first to the last move.

columns.name: from_rate_pct
columns.description: The rate before the cycle began (upper bound for a range).

columns.name: to_rate_pct
columns.description: The rate after the cycle’s last move.

columns.name: is_current
columns.description: True for the most recent cycle, which may still be running.

configs.name: annual
configs.description: Yearly summaries computed from `rates` and `decisions`: the rate at each end of the year, its range, the net and gross change, and how many hikes, cuts and holds there were.
configs.grain: One row per country per calendar year

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the jurisdiction (EA for the euro area).

columns.name: year
columns.description: Calendar year.

columns.name: start_rate_pct
columns.description: The rate in force on 1 January (the latest change effective before it). Null when the series starts later in the year.

columns.name: end_rate_pct
columns.description: The rate in force on 31 December, or on the last observed date for the current year.

columns.name: min_rate_pct
columns.description: Lowest rate in force during the year.

columns.name: max_rate_pct
columns.description: Highest rate in force during the year.

columns.name: net_change_bps
columns.description: End minus start, in basis points. Null when the start is unknown.

columns.name: gross_hikes_bps
columns.description: Sum of hikes in the year, in basis points.

columns.name: gross_cuts_bps
columns.description: Sum of cuts in the year, in basis points (a positive number).

columns.name: hike_count
columns.description: Number of hikes.

columns.name: cut_count
columns.description: Number of cuts.

columns.name: hold_count
columns.description: Number of announced holds. Null where the decision ledger does not cover the whole year.

columns.name: decision_count
columns.description: Number of announced decisions. Null where the decision ledger does not cover the whole year.

columns.name: is_partial_year
columns.description: True for a year the data does not fully cover: the first year of the series or the current year.

columns.name: record_text
columns.description: One deterministic sentence summarising the year, for search and retrieval. Generated from the fields, not written by a model.

configs.name: countries
configs.description: What each country’s data covers: the bank, the instrument, the dates covered and the release it was built from.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the jurisdiction (EA for the euro area).

columns.name: country
columns.description: Jurisdiction name.

columns.name: central_bank
columns.description: Central bank that sets the rate.

columns.name: central_bank_short
columns.description: Short name of the central bank.

columns.name: decision_body
columns.description: The committee that sets the rate.

columns.name: instrument
columns.description: The current policy instrument.

columns.name: instrument_explainer
columns.description: What the instrument is, in plain words.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: ISO 4217 currency code.

columns.name: time_zone
columns.description: IANA time zone of the bank’s announcements.

columns.name: series_from
columns.description: First point of the rate series.

columns.name: ledger_from
columns.description: First decision in the decision ledger; null where the ledger is still being added.

columns.name: observed_through
columns.description: Date the official series was last observed.

columns.name: coverage_note
columns.description: How the data was assembled, in the release’s own words.

columns.name: series_points
columns.description: Rows in `rates` for this country.

columns.name: decisions
columns.description: Rows in `decisions` for this country.

columns.name: central_bank_url
columns.description: The bank’s website.

columns.name: release_hash
columns.description: SHA-256 content hash of the release.

configs.name: eras
configs.description: The periods in which one instrument and basis applied. A change of era is why `change_bps` is null at its first point.

columns.name: era_id
columns.description: Era identifier.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the jurisdiction (EA for the euro area).

columns.name: from_date
columns.description: First date of the era.

columns.name: to_date
columns.description: Last date of the era; null while it continues.

columns.name: instrument
columns.description: The instrument in this era.

columns.name: level_kind
columns.description: `point` or `range`.

columns.name: basis
columns.description: `policy` or `observation`.

columns.name: note

columns.name: source_id

configs.name: events
configs.description: Dated events that help read the rate history. Context only, not causal claims.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the jurisdiction (EA for the euro area).

columns.name: date
columns.description: Event date.

columns.name: label
columns.description: Short label.

columns.name: description
columns.description: What happened.

columns.name: source_id
columns.description: Joins to `sources`.

configs.name: sources
configs.description: Every source the rows cite: official series, statements, calendars and labelled secondary sources.

columns.name: source_id
columns.description: Source identifier.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the jurisdiction (EA for the euro area).

columns.name: source_type
columns.description: Kind of source, for example `series`, `statement`, `calendar`, `secondary-series`.

columns.name: title
columns.description: Title as published.

columns.name: url
columns.description: Where to verify it.

columns.name: official
columns.description: True when published by the central bank itself (or the official statistical series it maintains).

columns.name: published_at
columns.description: Publication date or time, when known.

configs.name: transmission
configs.description: How the policy rate reaches common loans: the benchmark each is priced off, how often it resets and how directly a change passes through. Curated reference notes.
configs.grain: One row per loan product per country

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the jurisdiction (EA for the euro area).

columns.name: product

columns.name: benchmark
columns.description: What the rate is priced off.

columns.name: spread_bps
columns.description: Typical spread over the benchmark, where given.

columns.name: reset
columns.description: How often the rate resets.

columns.name: adjusts
columns.description: `payment`, `tenure` or `both`: what changes when the rate does.

columns.name: pass_through
columns.description: `direct`, `lagged`, `weak` or `none`.

columns.name: note
columns.description: Plain-language note.

columns.name: source_id
columns.description: Joins to `sources`.
